root_cause_label: Repeated Shell Heredoc and Base64 Mangling
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent repeatedly failed to write its Python generation script to the environment because the agent harness mangled heredoc content and corrupted base64 strings, leaving re.json either absent or containing an invalid lookbehind regex that crashed check.py on every run.
t_err_evidence: cat > generate_re.py << 'EOF' used for script with f-strings containing \n, causing heredoc mangling
t_commit_evidence: After step 3, the re.json file contains a regex with `(?<!START\s*)` (variable-width lookbehind) that will crash Python's re module; from this point the agent can never get a passing check.py run without first fixing this file, which never happens.
t_surface_evidence: re.PatternError: look-behind requires fixed-width pattern when check.py runs against old re.json
trigger_explanation: The agent assumes that `cat > file << 'EOF'` heredocs transmitted via JSON keystrokes in the Terminus2 harness faithfully write the intended multiline content; in reality the harness mangles newlines and interleaves lines, producing both scrambled Python scripts and an invalid re.json on step 3.
